requirements_summary: Workload: mix of real-time chat (low latency), reranking for auctions (high QPS), and nightly batch embeddings. Targets: p95 latency <= 75ms for chat, p50 token/sec throughput of 125k tokens/s for reranking during peak. Cost sensitivity: high — wants efficient batching + quantization suggestions. Model prefs: open LLaMA-derived and 70B variants with int8 quantization preferred. Routing: multi-region fallback and priority for Dedicated pool with hosted fallback. SLA asks: 99.9% uptime, clear MTTxR for failover, financial penalties in procurement for missed SLOs. Deployment: VPC-first, potential air-gapped for EU-sensitive customers.

notes:
Shorthand CRM notes:
- Customer runs adtech auctioning + user chat in same platform; strict latency for chat, reranking is throughput-limited.
- AE Jordan: emphasize deterministic latency SLOs and reserved capacity to avoid noisy neighbor in peak auctions.
- SE Alicia: recommended starting workshop with baseline QPS (steady 450 qps), peak 2200 qps; tokens/re-ranking workload averages 20 tokens per request (short prompts), but bidder scoring uses context windows up to 256 tokens during rerank stage.
- Sizing heuristics we discussed: sample microbenchmark shows ~55k tokens/sec per A100-80GB for int8 70B variant under continuous batching; expect 10-15% overhead for KV cache management in chat.
- Preliminary reserve calc: steady-state (450 qps * 20 tokens * avg 0.06s token latency) => baseline load; peak provisioning target is to sustain 2.2k qps with p95 <= 75ms, estimate 6-8 reserved GPUs with aggressive batching, or 10-12 for conservative headroom and failover.
- They asked for failure scenarios: region outage fallback plan, can Redwood route to hosted with degraded QoS? They want explicit MTTxR and failover timelines in SLA.
- Pricing ask: provide both committed monthly and annual tiers, plus overage pricing; want unit cost per 1M tokens under each commit tier.
- Blockers: procurement wants legal review on SLA penalties; security wants confirmation on KMS integration and audit log retention 7 years for regulated customers.
- Quote from CTO (paraphrased): "We can't have auction stalls — if latency spikes during peak campaigns we lose revenue immediately." — use to prioritize p95 SLO and reserved capacity.
- Next actions: run workshop 2026-03-10 (infra + SRE + cost ops), perform Redwood microbench, produce Reserved GPU options and draft SLA terms.
